$comment: Likely-usage factor per node resource for the scarcity objective O2 (A85). O2 weighs a resource usage / map total NNE, so a resource that is rare on the map but little needed costs less than its rarity alone says. A resource not listed has usage 1. Values must be > 0, and each needs a reason. Keys are game_data.json part names that appear in data/nodes.csv. Values are the scarcity weights v3 (2026-10-16, demand blend 10% standard / 90% all alternates, from the scarcity review): usage = final weight x map supply NNE / 29.025 (Kyalite's weight x supply, so Kyalite is 1), rounded to 4 decimals; O2 cost per NNE is then the v3 weight / 29.025. Edit a value and say why in its reason.
